value.text:
I need to evaluate each claim against the cited evidence. Let me go through each one carefully.

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-6648-02 is on the FDA shortage list as "Limited Availability" with FDA reason category "Other", manufacturer reports Manufacturing Delay, next delivery October 2026, estimated recovery December 2026." Cited: [shortage-0409-6648-02]

Evidence: "FDA shortage list: Dextrose Monohydrate 50%, Injection, 25 g/50 mL (NDC 0409-6648-02) from Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company; availability: "Limited Availability"; FDA reason category: "Other"; next delivery: October 2026; estimated recovery: December 2026; manufacturer reports: Manufacturing Delay; updated 10/08/2026"

This matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "We have 440 units on hand covering 23.4 days at 18.8 units per day." Cited: [stock-12]

Evidence: "dextrose DEXTROSE MONOHYDRATE 25 g/50mL (Hospira, Inc., NDC 0409-6648-02, NDA019445): 440 units on hand, 18.8/day over 30 days, 23.4 days of cover"

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "No ongoing recall for this NDC." Cited: [search-recall-12]

Evidence: "Searched this run's FDA ongoing-recall snapshot for our package NDC 0409-6648-02 and product 0409-6648: no ongoing recall."

Matches. Supported.

Claim 4: substitution: "Our current product NDA019445 has TE code AP; OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563 also has TE code AP in the Orange Book, making them therapeutic equivalents." Cited: [ob-NDA019445-001, ob-NDA018563-001]

Evidence ob-NDA019445-001: "Orange Book: DEXTROSE 50% 500MG/ML (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by HOSPIRA INC, application NDA019445, TE code AP (our current product)"

Evidence ob-NDA018563-001: "Orange Book: DEXTROSE 50% IN PLASTIC CONTAINER 50GM/100ML (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC, application NDA018563, TE code AP"

Both have TE code AP. The claim says they are therapeutic equivalents. Since both have TE code AP, they are both therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug, and thus considered therapeutically equivalent to each other. This is a reasonable conclusion. Supported.

Claim 5: substitution: "OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563 packages at our concentration are not on the FDA shortage list (status-NDA018563)." Cited: [status-NDA018563]

Evidence: "Checked OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563: 1 package(s) at our concentration in the FDA product listing (0990-7936-19 by ICU Medical Inc.: not on the FDA shortage list); no ongoing recall on these products. Result: none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list."

Matches exactly. Supported.

Claim 6: substitution: "OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563: Orange Book AP code matches our product; none of its packages at our concentration are on the FDA shortage list (status-NDA018563)." Cited: [status-NDA018563, ob-NDA018563-001, ob-NDA019445-001, ndc-0990-7936]

Need to check if all cited evidence supports the claim. The claim combines two facts: Orange Book AP code matches our product, and none of its packages at our concentration are on the FDA shortage list.

Evidence:
- status-NDA018563: says none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list.
- ob-NDA018563-001: Orange Book: DEXTROSE 50% IN PLASTIC CONTAINER 50GM/100ML (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC, application NDA018563, TE code AP
- ob-NDA019445-001: Orange Book: DEXTROSE 50% 500MG/ML (INJECTABLE;INJECTION) by HOSPIRA INC, application NDA019445, TE code AP (our current product)
- ndc-0990-7936: openFDA NDC directory: Dextrose DEXTROSE MONOHYDRATE 50 g/100mL (INJECTION, SOLUTION) by ICU Medical Inc., NDA018563; packages: 0990-7936-19 (500 mL in 1 BAG); listing valid to 20271231

The claim says "Orange Book AP code matches our product" - both have TE code AP, so this is supported. "none of its packages at our concentration are on the FDA shortage list" - status-NDA018563 says exactly that. The ndc-0990-7936 provides additional context about the package. All evidence supports the claim. Supported.

Claim 7: substitution: "OTSUKA ICU MEDICAL LLC NDA018563: Orange Book AP code matches our product; no ongoing recall on these products (status-NDA018563)." Cited: [status-NDA018563, ob-NDA018563-001, ob-NDA019445-001, ndc-0990-7936]

Evidence:
- status-NDA018563: "no ongoing recall on these products"
- ob-NDA018563-001: TE code AP for Otsuka
- ob-NDA019445-001: TE code AP for current product
- ndc-0990-7936: NDC directory info

The claim says "Orange Book AP code matches our product" - supported by both Orange Book entries showing TE code AP. "no ongoing recall on these products" - directly supported by status-NDA018563. Supported.

All claims appear to be supported by the evidence. No factual problems found.</think>{"unsupported":[]}
